topic_a_inefficiencies.description: DuckDuckGoParser HTML parser class copy-pasted identically across 4 files: method_websearch.py, method_iterative.py, method_wikipedia.py, method_arxiv.py.
Two separate benchmark_runner.py files exist at different paths with different quality scoring algorithms and method lists.
Stop words list duplicated in 3 places with slightly different contents: dedup_utils.py, method_iterative.py, method_hybrid.py.
scripts/index.json contains stress-test-generated placeholder entries (SCR-0001 to SCR-0020) that don't correspond to actual functional code.
cross-references.json references TOOL-0001 through TOOL-0020 that are phantom stress-test entries.
All index.json files use read-modify-write with no atomic write mechanism. Flagged by TEAM-0001 but never fixed.
__pycache__ directories present in repo under multiple directories.
cross_reference_results in method_hybrid.py has O(n^2) complexity with repeated keyword extraction.
Wikipedia method returns only 1 result (quality 10/100) despite 340 lines of code. User-Agent issue identified in iteration 1 but never fixed.
No full-text search across KB entry content. Tag index is manually maintained and can drift.
teams/ directory has no index.json or machine-readable catalog.
Team ID references inconsistent: KB-0004 uses 'TEAM-2' while others use 'TEAM-XXXX' format.
Wikidata method blocked (403) adding latency with zero return. Hybrid should skip known-blocked sources.
Every entry has date 2026-03-10, making temporal ordering impossible.
benchmarks/schema.json defines fields never populated in actual results.
